sessions.title: Edgar Wright’s Closet Picks
sessions.description: The writer and director returns to the Criterion Closet, where he talks about a moment from Black Narcissus that’s ingrained in his memory, shares what he loves about Max Ophuls and The Earrings of Madame de . . ., and reflects on how Richard Lester captured lightning in a bottle with A Hard Day’s Night.

sessions.title: Edgar Wright’s Closet Picks
sessions.description: The genre-obsessed British director celebrates cult classics that have made a deep impression on him.
